items.title: Kalshi: Fed decision in October?
items.claim: At pool access time 13:35 UTC on September 24, the direct page displayed 63% for Hike 25bps, 35% for Fed maintains rate, and 2% for Hike >25bps.

items.title: Polymarket: Fed Decision in October?
items.claim: At pool access time 13:35 UTC on September 24, the direct page displayed 64% for a 25 bp increase and 36% for no change; its rules use the upper-bound target-range change and name the October FOMC statement as resolution source.

items.title: CME FedWatch
items.claim: CME describes FedWatch as probabilities implied by 30-Day Fed Funds futures, but the direct live October grid was unreadable in this check.

items.title: BEA: U.S. International Transactions and Investment Position, Q2 2026
items.claim: Released September 24 at 08:30 EDT: the U.S. current-account deficit widened $33.4 billion to $246.0 billion in the second quarter.

items.title: BLS September 2026 release calendar
items.claim: The calendar lists the August Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey at 10:00 ET on September 29.

items.title: BEA release schedule

items.title: Federal Reserve October 2026 calendar
items.claim: The calendar lists September meeting minutes on October 7 at 14:00 ET and the October 27–28 meeting, statement at 14:00 ET and press conference at 14:30 ET on October 28.
